landing.hero_a: A pixel world made from a random seed
landing.tag: A tiny pixel world that lives on its own, until you decide it shouldn't.
landing.soon: Concept preview. The game is still being built.
landing.god_h: You are the god. The world doesn't wait for you.
landing.god_p: Four races, 32 creatures and 21 biomes share one map. Villagers are born, farm, marry, pray, argue and go to war. Kingdoms rise and fall with or without you. Step in with a meteor, a blessing or a plague, and watch what happens next.
landing.world_p: Top down pixel art that reads from a whole continent down to a single villager. Kingdom colors show who owns what at a glance.
landing.mock_a: Four kingdoms share a continent while a dragon circles a capital
landing.i_quote: “The mountain gave us iron. The elves gave us trouble.”
landing.races_p: Each race has its own land, strengths and habits. Children inherit genes from both parents, and isolated groups can become new subspecies.
landing.humans_d: Balanced, fast learners, build the biggest kingdoms. They can settle anywhere.
landing.elves_d: Best archers and long lived. They plant forests instead of cutting them.
landing.orcs_d: Strong, fearless and quick to breed. They start more wars.
landing.dwarves_d: Tough miners and smiths. They tunnel through mountains.
landing.beasts_p: From sheep to dragons. Some are food, some are danger, and one is a giant crab you can drive through a city.
landing.sheep_d: Grazes on grassland and flees wolves.
landing.wolf_d: Hunts in packs and chases lone villagers.
landing.slime_d: Splits in two every time it is hit.
landing.ghost_d: Drifts through walls and scares people away.
landing.dragon_d: Breathes fire, raids towns and hoards gold.
landing.claw_d: A giant crab you can steer through a city. Stomp, sweep, laser.
landing.ufo_d: Abducts people and sometimes returns them changed.
landing.build_p: Every building has its own roof and shape, so you can tell a smithy from a temple from across the map.
landing.house_d: Homes grow from huts into stone houses as a village ages.
landing.temple_d: Priests gather faith here. Bigger temples are heard louder.
landing.smithy_d: Dwarves forge tools and weapons here. Smoke means work.
landing.keep_d: The seat of a kingdom, flying its colors.
landing.mine_d: Copper, iron and gold. The usual reason for war.
landing.bio_p: Twenty one biomes, from grassland to haunted battlefields, including rare magic patches. A few of them:
landing.forest_d: Wood and berries. Bears and deer.
landing.desert_d: Hot and dry. Gold flecks, little food.
landing.tundra_d: Cold and sparse. Foxes and penguins.
landing.haunted_d: Corruption spreads. Undead walk at night.
landing.pow_p: About 60 powers, each with a brush size and an effect you can see in under a tenth of a second.
landing.shape_d: Raise land, paint biomes, drop a volcano.
landing.grace_d: Bless, heal, bring rain, work a miracle.
landing.gene_d: Mutate, add traits, split a subspecies.
landing.wld_d: Pause, speed up, save, start over.
landing.war_h: Raise armies. Or let them raise themselves.
landing.war_p: Barracks train soldiers, generals lead them, and kingdoms fight wars on their own. Take command any time: pick an army, tap the map, and it marches.
landing.war_a: A human army marches on an orc wall while archers shoot from the battlements
landing.a_sub: Human kingdom, at war with the Redtusk Orcs
landing.pos_p: Possess a single villager and play them like an action game. The world keeps running around you. A farmer is weak. A champion is not.
landing.story_p: Every named person, war and religion goes into the chronicle. Here is what a few idle centuries might look like.
landing.l1: Year 31The Redtusk Orcs declare war on the Hill Dwarves over a copper mine.
landing.l2: Year 88Cut off by a mountain range, one orc clan becomes the Ashfoot Orcs.
landing.l3: Year 140A UFO abducts a priest and returns him with a new religion.
landing.l4: Year 203Clawzilla wrecks the capital of Elmwick. The elves replant it.
landing.l5: Year 344A dwarf smith forges the first mythril axe and names it Oathbreaker.
landing.tut_h: Never played a god game? Good.
landing.tut_p: A ten step tutorial runs the first time you play. Arrows point at the right button, and a checklist ticks itself off as you go. Replay it any time.
landing.s3: Spawn humans and watch them build
landing.road_p: The game is built in phases, and every phase ends in a build you can play. Follow along on GitHub.
landing.r0_d: The execution plan and this page.
landing.r1_d: Repository, build pipeline and automatic publishing.
landing.r2_d: Generator, biomes, renderer, camera, terrain tools, saves.
landing.r3_d: Animals, 4 races, genes, minds, villages, roads.
landing.r4_d: Economy, tech ages, gear, culture, religion, diplomacy.
landing.r5_d: Armies, command tool, walls, towers, sieges, possession.
landing.r6_d: Disasters, monsters, Clawzilla, UFOs, zombies, nukes.
landing.r7_d: Charts, pyramids, war history, death stats, leaderboards.
landing.r8_d: Tutorial, Codex, achievements, sound, phone controls, balance.
landing.foot: Plays in any modern browser on desktop or phone, online or offline from one file. All art on this page is original and drawn in code.

play.title: Pocket Pantheon
play.tip_pan: Drag to look around without changing anything.
play.tip_raise: Lift the land under your brush.
play.tip_lower: Sink the land. Go deep enough and the sea rushes in.
play.tip_flatten: Level the ground to the height where you started.
play.tip_paint: Paint any biome straight onto the map.
play.tip_island: Drop a whole island into the sea.
play.tip_volcano: Push up a volcano ringed with infernal ground.
play.tip_range: Raise a ridge of mountains. Every click points a new way.
play.tip_new: Roll a fresh world with your own settings.
play.tip_saves: Three slots plus an autosave every 2 minutes.
play.tip_export: Download this world as a file.
play.tip_import: Open a world file you saved before.
play.tip_fit: Zoom out to see the entire map.
play.sv_fail: That didn't work. Your browser might be blocking storage.
play.sv_bad_file: That file isn't a Pocket Pantheon world.
play.resumed: Welcome back. Your world is right where you left it.
play.fallback: Your device can't run WebGL2, so the simple renderer is on.
play.in_hint: Click anywhere on the map to see what's there.
play.help: Right drag or two fingers to move. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Keys 1 to 8 switch tabs, the bracket keys change the brush, and H opens the stats.
play.tip_life: Click the map to drop creatures. A bigger brush brings more.
play.tip_pick: Click someone to work on them.
play.tip_mutate: Shuffle a few genes and add a random trait.
play.tip_clone: Make an identical twin right next to them.
play.ev_rebellion: {town} rebels against {old} and crowns the Kingdom of {name}.
play.ev_independence: Settlers in {town} break away from {old}. The Kingdom of {name} is born.
play.ev_faith_lost: The last follower of {faith} is gone.
play.ev_trade: {a} and {b} open their markets to each other.
play.ev_subspecies: A new people takes shape in {kingdom}: the {name} {race}.
play.ev_revive: A band of {race} walks in from the edge of the world.
play.why_revive: The Director brought them back. They had been gone for 20 years.
play.why_crowded: The Director raised the odds of disease because the world is close to its limit.
play.tip_rain: Soak the land. Crops nearby grow faster.
play.tip_bless: A golden aura for 2 years. Blessed people hit harder.
play.tip_heal: Mend wounds and fill every need.
play.tip_inspire: Hand the kingdom here a burst of new ideas.
play.tip_bounty: Fill the nearest town's stores with food.
play.tip_peace: Make the kingdoms here like each other a lot more.
play.tip_miracle: Bring back the people who died here not long ago.
play.tip_split: Turn this person's town into a new subspecies.
play.tip_director: How hard the World Director nudges your world.
play.tip_select: Click a soldier to pick their army, or a town hall to pick its kingdom.
play.tip_move: Click the map. The army walks there and holds.
play.tip_attack: Click an enemy town. The army marches on it and lays siege.
play.tip_defend: Click a friendly town or spot. The army guards it.
play.tip_hold: Stand still and fight only what comes close.
play.tip_retreat: Fall back to the home town.
play.tip_recruit: Click a town to train soldiers. It costs 10 food and 5 gold.
play.tip_possess: Click anyone and play them yourself.
play.tip_war: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of the kingdom it should attack.
play.tip_peace_k: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of the kingdom it should stop fighting.
play.tip_ally: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of its new friend.
play.ev_army: {kingdom} raises the Army of {name} with {n} soldiers.
play.why_peace: The Director stirred things up after 80 years without a war.
play.poss_hint: WASD or the arrows to walk, Space to jump, J to attack, T to talk, E to interact, Esc to let go.
play.poss_lost: Your body didn't make it. Back to the heavens.
play.tip_w_lightning: One bolt. 60 damage, and it may start a fire.
play.tip_w_fire: Set the land alight. It spreads through grass, trees and wooden houses.
play.tip_w_tornado: A funnel that wanders for 20 seconds, throwing people and tearing off roofs.
play.tip_w_earthquake: Cracks the ground and brings down stone buildings. Mountains may open a vent.
play.tip_w_meteor: A rock from the sky. It leaves a crater ringed with fire.
play.tip_w_acid: A drifting cloud that eats at people, houses and crops.
play.tip_w_plague: Starts on the nearest person and spreads by contact. Survivors may come out immune.
play.tip_w_zombie: Turns the nearest person. Every bite makes another zombie.
play.tip_w_volcano: Raise a volcano that erupts for a minute. Lava runs downhill.
play.tip_w_flood: Rivers and coasts spill over. Afterwards the soil is richer.
play.tip_w_blizzard: Snow for a year. Everyone slows down and crops fail.
play.tip_w_drought: Three dry years. Crops halve and wildfires come easily.
play.tip_w_nuke: Flattens everything nearby. The fallout takes 200 years to heal.
play.tip_frequency: How often nature strikes on its own.
play.ev_nuke: A blinding flash. Nothing near it will grow for 200 years.
play.ev_abducted: A light in the sky takes {name} away.
play.ev_returned: {name} is back, and something about them has changed.
play.why_quiet: The Director rolled a natural disaster after 10 quiet years.
play.poss_giant: Space to stomp, J to sweep your claws, E for the eye laser.
play.st_none_religion: No faith has been founded yet.
play.st_none_subspecies: No subspecies has split off yet.
play.st_empty: Nothing recorded yet. Let a year or two pass.
play.st_war_hint: Click a war to read its battle log.
play.st_war_none: No wars yet. Peace holds, for now.
play.st_tree_title: Kingdoms, their splits and their falls
play.st_tree_hint: Each kingdom hangs under the one it split from. Click a living kingdom to visit it.
play.st_why_war: It happened during the war of {a} against {b}, which began in year {n} with {r}.
play.st_why_loyalty: Loyalty ran low in towns far from the capital, so they broke away.
play.st_why_none: No single cause was recorded. Sometimes the world just turns.
play.st_png_none: Switch to a chart to save an image.
